headline: Government moves to ban social media for under-16s
text: The Government announced a move toward restricting social media access for New Zealanders under 16, with Deputy PM Winston Peters responding to the announcement live on air.

headline: Latest poll delivers bad news for coalition and Labour alike
text: The latest RNZ-Reid Research poll shows declining support for both the governing coalition and the Labour opposition, with smaller parties picking up ground ahead of the 7 November election.

headline: Te Pāti Māori's split-vote strategy sparks MMP debate
text: At its Gisborne campaign launch, Te Pāti Māori told supporters to give their electorate vote to the party but direct their party vote to left-aligned allies instead — a tactic commentators say could produce a Parliament that doesn't match the popular vote.

headline: Poll shows majority support for restricting voting to citizens
text: New polling shows a majority of New Zealanders support restricting general election voting rights to citizens only, rather than including permanent residents — a policy NZ First has campaigned on.
